channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Publix removing 10-item limit from express checkout lanes
item.description: Publix is removing 10-item limits at express checkout lanes as the grocery chain says it aims to reduce wait times and improve efficiency.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Health officials confirm locally acquired dengue case in Citrus County: DOH
item.description: Health officials have confirmed a locally acquired case of dengue in Citrus County, according to the Florida Department of Health (DOH) in Citrus County.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Tampa mayor, Ismaili Muslim community plant 250 trees at Rowlett Park in honor of America 250
item.description: Fireworks and parades are standard fare for national milestone celebrations, but a community group in Tampa is marking America’s 250th anniversary by putting down deep roots.
